title: A Figure with Its Caption
prompt:
When an image needs a visible caption, wrap it in a `figure` element and use `figcaption`. Build one: the `figure` contains an `img` (`/images/market.jpg`, alt `A crowded farmers market on a Saturday morning`) and a `figcaption` reading `Saturday, 7 a.m.`

Rules:
- `img` and `figcaption` both live inside the `figure`.
- The caption is visible text, not alt text.
boilerplate: Where the week begins

tests.name: a figure wraps both elements
image with src and alt
tests.hint: Both attributes on the img, exactly as the instructions spell them.

tests.name: visible caption text
